_comment: Deterministic post templates for build_queue.py (Page bot) and api/_lib/groups-plan.js (group queue). Adapted from the styles in new-post-templates.js (resort, trybeforebuy, roi, lifestyle2, rental) with all hardcoded figures removed: every number must come from properties.json through placeholders. Style order defines the date-based rotation. Optional 'types' restricts a style to those property types (e.g. daily_life makes no sense for development land); the rotation advances to the next style when the day's property type is not allowed.
_skeleton_comment: styles[].templates[lang] is a SKELETON, not the finished post. It carries the fixed connective tissue of the style plus five composition slots that the renderer fills from styles[].parts[lang]: {opener} {highlights} {closer} {hashtags} {cta}. Placeholders allowed in a skeleton: {name} {price} {neighborhood} {opener} {highlights} {closer} {hashtags} {cta} {wa_link}. The skeleton must end with {cta} on its own line followed by {wa_link} on the next line: the Page bot prints the link there, and the group queue drops that line (the wa.me link goes in the first comment, never in the body) and prints 'details in the first comment' in its place, so the CTA survives in both.
_parts_comment: parts[lang] holds the interchangeable pieces: openers/closers/ctas (5 each) and hashtag_sets (3 each, as arrays of tags). The renderer picks one of each with a deterministic seed derived from date + group code + property slug + style id (the Page bot uses date + slug + style, it has no group). Same request twice = same text, always; different day, group or property = different text. Placeholders allowed inside a part: {name} {price} {neighborhood} {highlight_1} {highlight_2}. NEVER write a figure into a part: numbers come from properties.json only. Banned vocabulary in every language: lujo, paraiso, sueno, exclusivo, oportunidad unica, luxury, paradise, dream, exclusive (and their French twins reve, luxe, paradis, exclusif). CONFOTUR is NEVER mentioned in a part either: it can only reach a post through a highlight of a property whose confotur field is exactly true (today only cocotal-2bdr), and the renderer strips CONFOTUR highlights from every other property.
_layout_comment: highlight_layouts rotates the visual mold of the highlights so the posts do not all share the same shape. Each layout renders as prefix + highlight, joined by 'join'. How MANY highlights show (2 or 3), which ones and in what order is picked from the same seed, in code (pickHighlights / pick_highlights). Both renderers (JS and Python) read this list, so adding a layout here adds it in both.
